description: StationGod and the game server: mod version, health and costs, profiling, the in-game console. command is a cheat.
help: StationGod and the game server: mod version, health and costs, profiling, the in-game console. command is a cheat.
- info: the running mod: version, per-method calls and times, game members, its cost to the game, and live script runs with status and cost
- profiling: profile StationGod's main-thread cost: on, off, reset, report
- console: the latest in-game console lines, oldest first
- stop: stop a script run or job, or every live run with no id (finally blocks run; the reply lists what it left changed)
- command: run any console command and answer what it printed: spawn, delete, teleport, storms, settings. Cheat, not undoable. (cheat)
Shaping on every call: fields, omit, list_limits, output_file, whole, repeat (help {topic: "shaping"}).
help {verb: "server", what} gives a what's options, reply keys and an example.

stop.summary: stop a script run or a job; with no id, every live run of this session. A script run gets sg.Stopped (a BaseException) once, at its next sg call (at once inside sg.wait or sg.watch), so its finally blocks run: after it, reads and writes act, while waits and watches raise at once. The worker is killed 5 s after the stop (longer while an sg call is in flight, never past 30 s), or on a second stop. A running job is allowed to settle
